# Custom Ink

> > Custom Ink is an online platform for designing and ordering custom apparel, promotional products, and branded merchandise with no minimum orders and fast fulfillment.

Custom Ink specializes in on-demand custom apparel production using their Design Lab tool, supporting individual orders through large group campaigns. The platform serves diverse use cases including fundraising, corporate branding, events, and group ordering with options for rush delivery.

## Key Topics

- Custom apparel design
- No minimum orders
- Bulk ordering
- Design Lab tool
- T-shirt customization
- Promotional products
- Group orders
- Rush delivery
- Branded merchandise
- Super Rush delivery
- Embroidery and logo customization
- Gildan, Bella+Canvas, Comfort Colors
- Personalized support
- Fundraising platform

## Core Products & Apparel

- [Custom T-shirts: Design & Make Your Own Custom Shirts Online](https://www.customink.com/products/t-shirts/4): Design custom t-shirts with free shipping, no minimums, hundreds of styles
- [Custom Apparel: Design Your Own Custom & Branded Clothing Online](https://www.customink.com/products/apparel/857): Design custom apparel with Design Lab tool, free shipping and live help
- [Custom Sweatshirts & Hoodies | Design Personalized & Embroidered Sweatshirts & Hoodies](https://www.customink.com/products/sweatshirts/13): Design custom sweatshirts and hoodies with 100+ styles and bulk discounts
- [Custom Hats: Design Branded Hats with Your Logo | Custom Hat Designer](https://www.customink.com/products/hats/1): Design custom hats and baseball caps with logo embroidery and branding
- [Custom Outerwear & Jackets | Design Branded Logo Jackets](https://www.customink.com/products/jackets/14): Design custom jackets and outerwear with embroidery and logo customization
